$comment: TEST FIXTURE / SNAPSHOT of the live `module_registry` DB table (the authoritative editor-field vocabulary), captured read-only. This is NOT the runtime registry and MUST NOT be treated as an editable source of truth — the live contract is the DB table (seeded from BUILT_IN_MODULES in the CMS repo). Refresh via a read-only script (see CANONICAL_CONTRACT_CI_SPEC.md §13); do not hand-edit to 'fix' a finding. Used by contract.coverage.test.ts to run offline without DB credentials.
$freshness: STALE-RISK PROTECTION (Phase 2, Option A): this snapshot carries capturedAt + source + moduleCount. The test asserts INTERNAL CONSISTENCY (moduleCount === number of module keys) so a partial/corrupt edit is caught, and reports the capturedAt so reviewers can judge staleness. This does NOT make the snapshot automatically fresh — it can still drift from the live DB between refreshes. CI never queries production. Treat as 'unverified/stale-risk' until a dated refresh; only a manual read-only refresh (script) makes it 'verified as of capturedAt'.
